entities.name: Night of Fire
entities.description: A massacre in the city of Estark in which the House of Oor-tael was burned.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: The city on Dominaria where the Night of Fire occurred.

entities.name: Kuthuman
entities.description: Grand Master who ordered a tribute of mana from every house for his ascension.

entities.name: House of Oor-tael
entities.description: A house that refused to give its blue and green mana and was destroyed.

entities.name: Zarel Ewine
entities.description: A conspirator who destroyed Oor-tael to become Grand Master.

entities.name: Uriah Aswark
entities.description: A dwarf who betrayed House Oor-tael and became Zarel's second.

entities.name: Cullinarn
entities.description: A member of House Oor-tael who burned alive after teleporting his wife and child away.

entities.name: Festival of the Arena
entities.description: Festival at whose 978th final evening the massacre occurred.

events.summary: Kuthuman ordered a great tribute of mana from every house; Oor-tael refused its blue and green mana, and Zarel conspired with four houses to destroy them.
events.quote: Zarel Ewine conspired with the other four houses to destroy them so he could become the Grand Master.

events.summary: Uriah Aswark betrayed his house, giving away its secrets and unbarring its gates.
events.quote: The dwarf Uriah Aswark betrayed his house, giving away its secrets and unbarring the house's gates.

events.summary: Zarel and the four houses stormed the grounds and set fire to all buildings; Cullinarn and countless others burned alive.
events.quote: Zarel Ewine and the four conspiring houses stormed the grounds and set fire to all its buildings.

events.summary: Cullinarn teleported his wife and child Galin far away.
events.quote: He teleported his wife and child, Galin , far away.

events.summary: Kuthuman completed his ascension, leaving Zarel the Grand Master with Uriah as his second.
events.quote: leaving Zarel the Grand Master, with Uriah as his second

events.summary: Zarel had former members and anyone associated with them arrested and executed; thousands died.
events.quote: After the massacre, Zarel had any former member, suspected former member, or person who conversed with or harbored such a person arrested.

relations.note: Became his second as Grand Master.
relations.quote: leaving Zarel the Grand Master, with Uriah as his second
Zarel Ewine conspired with the other four houses to destroy them so he could become the Grand Master.
